messages:
nicole: heads-up  vendor reached out about "OOM during quiet window" for eu-west1 burst pools. We have nightly evals 23:50-02:00 UTC; need ~4 GPUs. can we confirm spare capacity? @priya @omar

priya: which pool exactly? burst-evals or reserve-demo? prefer H100 but ok with A100 fallback.

nicole: burst-evals. telemetry shows KV cache evictions at ~23:45, not sure if it's workload or cluster-wide.

eng-vendor-lee: vendor here 1 I can offer 1 H100 immediately and 2 A100s for short borrow in eu-west1 but need manifest + tenant + billing tag. H100 availability looks tight tonight.

omar: pinging infra  can we throttle the eval job to reduce peak mem? quick patch available to lower kv_cache.max_entries from 1M to 400k. rollback in 5m if issues.

priya: open procurement ticket with billing code RED-DEMO-11, assigning to @nicole to confirm with lee.

capacity-bot: Tentative hold created: 2026-03-22 23:50-2026-03-23 02:00 UTC  1 H100 + 2 A100 (eu-west1). Expires 2026-03-22 21:30 UTC unless confirmed.

nicole: manifest pasted: tenant=redwood-demo-9c4, workload=nightly-evals, start=2026-03-22T23:50Z, dur=2h10m, gpu_mix=1xH100,2xA100

eng-vendor-lee: received. Holding tentatively until 21:30 UTC. Please DM if you need extend.

omar: i've pushed kv cache patch to a branch and left a short CR note. quick test looked ok, but please LGTM if you want it tonight.

priya: ticket PROJ-8820 created and assigned to @nicole. noted rollback plan in ticket. :thumbsup:

nicole: i'll confirm by 21:00 UTC after quick perf run. thanks everyone.
